QuestInfo.name: [Black Wings] Eliminate the Failure 1
QuestInfo.0: The Black Wing mad scientist #b#p2154009##k in #m310060000# in the Mine is looking pretty unpleasant. Talk to #p2154009#.
QuestInfo.1: #p2154009# says his experiments aren't going smoothly because there have been too many failure Androids. He wants you to tell #b#p2154012##k to eliminate the #o8105003#.

0.0: Aaah, I can't continue my experiments! My headache just won't go away. And now even the creatures I've captured have run away. I need to take care of this before I can continue my experiments. Hey you! You there! Can you hear me?

yes.0: Go tell #b#p2154012##k to eliminate the #o8105003# enemies! I bet it'll be a lot quieter when there's 80 less of them. Why are you giving me that look? They're just failures to me!

no.0: Can't you hear me? You useless thing! Do I need to replace your ears with a sound detector or something?

1.0: Do not initiate prohibited conversation. I obey only the commands of Doctor #p2154009#. You may speak if you have a message from Doctor #p2154009#. \r\n#L0# #b(You deliver #p2154009#'s order.)#l\n#k
1.1: Type NE-00. Personal Name: #p2154012#. Fully operational.

npc.0: Have you not gone to #b#p2154012##k yet? This is so annoying. Nothing is going right!
